p_value_relaxed.reason: JS chi2CDF uses series expansion approximation; SciPy uses regularized incomplete gamma

stress_large_dataset.reason: Floating-point accumulation in large arrays reduces precision

test_cases.description: Small normal sample (n=10) — should not reject H0
Medium normal sample (n=20) — clear normal distribution
Large normal sample (n=50) — in the reliable asymptotic range
Heavy-tailed data (t-distribution-like) — should detect excess kurtosis
All identical values — zero variance should throw error
Perfectly symmetric data — skewness = 0, JB should be small
Large normal sample (n=10000) — performance and numerical stability

performance.note: Should complete in under 200ms on modern hardware
